card.name: Linking words in drug label text
card.fires_on: Small linking words or marks (can, as, of, a comma) and the digit 3 in CYP3A4, in drug-label sentences. It also fires on the gap before an age range.

modes.label: Linking words
modes.description: A small word such as can, as or of that comes right before a following term.
